blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Various groups in Mindanao welcomed the visit of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, the first ever by a Brazilian head of state, to the Philippines, but frowned upon the expected arrival of another leader from the Western Hemisphere. Lula was on a two-day state visit in the country starting on Friday, two weeks after securing a fourth presidential term that saw a strong pushback against right-wing challenger Flavio Bolsonaro.
